outcome.technical:
MEASURED FIRST. A git-call profiler (usercustomize shim on PYTHONPATH that logs every git child with its Python caller chain) over a whole base sweep counted 105954 git calls. Place questions (rev-parse --git-common-dir/--show-toplevel/--git-dir) made up about a quarter of git child-time. Ranked by site: _locks.lock_dir 14351 calls (190.8 s child-wall, loaded), _config.checkout_top 4356 (59.7 s), _worktrees.tree_root 3381 (46.7 s), _worktrees.admin_dir 2960 (39.9 s). Almost all were repeats within one process. The drive-phase carry path (carry_git: ls-files/diff/status/update-index on a scratch index) asks things that change between calls, so it is not memoisable.

CHANGE. (1) hooks/_config.py: one shared place memo behind the one door git_place(cwd, fields, timeout) -> (answers, why), with _git_rev_parse as its answers-only wrapper and _ask_rev_parse as the raw process. Only place fields are kept, keyed by (cwd, realpath, fields). Each answer is stored beside a witness that is re-read from disk before every reuse: the identity of the top's .git entry (a dir by dev/ino; a gitfile by dev/ino/size/mtime_ns) plus no .git between the directory and its top (_inside_known_tree). A refusal is kept only while no repository (a .git entry or a bare HEAD/objects/refs dir) stands anywhere above. An environment steering discovery (GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, GIT_COMMON_DIR, GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES, GIT_DISCOVERY_ACROSS_FILESYSTEM) bypasses the memo. A bare repository falls back to asking for the fields alone. forget_git_standing() clears the memo. (2) _locks.lock_dir and _worktrees.admin_dir/tree_root (new _place helper) ask through _loader.load_hooks_config().git_place. _worktrees still asks an injected runner, or a _git a test replaced, and still asks a cwd of None the old way. Both modules gain a _loader import edge, and PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md's generated module map is updated by those two lines (test__deps g1). (3) integrate-task.refresh_records: the two ls-files listings are one `ls-files -z -c -o --exclude-standard` (same union, checked on a fixture with a tracked-but-ignored file). (4) tests/test_drive_phase.py: new ip-block with ip1-ip3 (stub script sets an env var, chdirs, sys.exit('x')/3/0; checks argv, cwd, env and status, and that nothing outlives the run). The runner comment now states that lock-holder liveness is not exercised in-process: the holder pid is the suite's own. (5) tests/test__config.py (outside the declared files; the plan gate allowed the Edit): st1-st7 compare every memo answer with git asked fresh. They cover: a reuse starts no process; a worktree re-added at the same path under another admin dir; a repo initialised below the old top; a checkout moved away; a kept refusal plus a later git init; a bare repo; GIT_DIR. (6) .github/sweep-costs.json re-recorded with --record-costs from quiet run 3.

EFFECT. Re-profiled whole sweep: git calls 105954 -> 84549. lock_dir 14351->2105, checkout_top 4356->451, tree_root 3381->787, admin_dir 2960->650, refresh_records 1448->1267. QUIET TIMINGS: same command `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py`, /usr/bin/time -p. Each run started only when 1-min load < 4 and no other sweep, playwright or measure-affected process was running, and a sampler every 15 s saw none during the run. After: 314.68 s at 13:01:08Z (start load 3.69), 315.91 s at 13:27:15Z (start load 2.58); 26 min gap, 1.2 s spread; CPU user+sys 2122.0 / 2127.6 s. Base c57e3f3c, same conditions in a scratch worktree (since removed): 350.40 s at 13:08:58Z (load 3.40), 351.45 s at 13:34:02Z (load 3.99); CPU 2380.6 / 2381.6 s. So -36 s wall (-10%) and -255 s CPU (-11%). test_drive_phase slot-seconds 1050 -> 858. NOT under 240 s on either run; the target is not claimed. Step 3 was not done: after this change the rest of the sweep's git time sits in callers outside this task's files (_scoped_commit, _tree_stamp, _commit_trail, fixtures).

GATES. Brief gate `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tests/test_drive_phase.py` exit 0, 676 cases. Full sweep green three times: 193/193 files, 17644 cases (quiet2, quiet3, plus a loaded run). Re-checked after recording costs: test_stamp_verification, tools/sweep-selftests.py, tools/gate-parity.py, test__runner_output, test_run_test_gate all ok; `python3 tools/gate-parity.py` exit 0. `bench-hooks.py --gate` exit 0. ruff and vermin clean on all changed .py. bench-hooks h6 failed only under the profiling shim, which injects imports; it passes in every unprofiled run.

DEPENDANTS. _config (71 importers, every hook): same answers, now from a per-process memo; a hook is one process per call, so it barely changes; test__config 370/370, all guard suites green. _worktrees (28 importers): admin_dir/tree_root give the same answers; injected runners and replaced _git are honoured (test_audit_task ff14 and test_panel_server fh1 counting spies green). _locks (40 importers, read by every guard): lock_dir gives the same directory and now decodes surrogateescape instead of replace; test__locks and test_audit_lock green. integrate-task (drive write path; test_integrate_task 35, test_drive_phase, test_commit_task_work green): its names used elsewhere are untouched, and its _deps exemption row still applies. drive-phase.py: not changed; it reaches the memo through _worktrees and _locks. test_drive_phase: one STAGES row added before sb-block; sb1 is green. test_stamp_verification: not changed.

CONSEQUENCE TO PUBLISH. The cost table was windows-latest (scaled), 4 workers. The re-record as ordered makes it darwin, 8 workers: test_drive_phase 2665.5 -> 858.1, ar18-block 196.8 -> 70.9. CI's windows shards are now balanced on darwin proportions, and each windows job's timeout falls to the 300 s floor. The largest windows figure was 196.8 s, still under the floor. Revert that one file if the windows table must stand.
